issues.text:
LD-5 section F (landing.test.js:894) cannot be made green by a fix inside my write_set without changing an owner's ruling. MEASURED on the Linux runner (run 44887506935, snapshot bc3af8d), speaker column right edge (.who) = window - 157.8 px: at 380 px it is 222.2 and at 389 px 231.2; the longest title ends at 227.4 (question 1) and 230.6 (question 5, «Проверяющий»), so it passes the column by 5.2 and 8.4 px at 380 and stands 0.4 px under the 4 px gap to «Назад» (back left 234.2) at question 5. Where it fits: at 389 px the slack is 0.6 px (column 231.2 against 230.6, the test tolerates 0.5), at 390 px 1.6 px. So with the runner's font the title needs a column from about 388.4 px of window; on macOS (the look 7.9, 130.4 px title, 190.4 px needed against 198.4 at 380) there are 8 px to spare. The font is a system stack with no @font-face, so the real visitor's width is neither the Mac's nor the runner's. ROOT CAUSE: О36 chose a fixed window threshold (379) with an 8 px slack measured on one font; a fixed width threshold cannot be robust to the font, and the sample's own 390 px has only 1.6 px of slack on the runner's font. The test is not wrong: it asks for 'no title beyond its column' and 'beside «Назад» from 380 px' as О36/О39 say. The code is wrong only against the platform-independent reading of the layout.

OPTIONS (each changes an owner's ruling or the look): (A) move the threshold up to max-width 387 or 388 px in site.css and the e2e constants OWN_ROW_UP_TO and the windows (380 and 389 expectations would then read 'own row'): changes О36 'below 380'; slack at 389 stays 0.6 px on the runner, so it is still no slack at the phone of the sample, and the test 389 px row must stay side by side only if the threshold is 388 or less; this is the smallest change but still tight. (B) keep 380 and the side-by-side from 380, and let the speaker row absorb the difference: in the 380-389 px window narrow the speaker's inner gap (12) and the head's column gap (10) by about 9 px in total, or set the title to 16 px; no ruling about the threshold changes but the look 7.9/D25 is changed in a measured place (a 1:1 mockup rule, owner's list G21) and the slack at 380 on the runner is about 0; not robust either. (C) make the layout content-driven instead of width-driven: the head wraps (flex-wrap or grid auto-fit) so that the speaker takes its own row exactly when its title does not fit beside «Назад» in the user's own font; then there is no font-dependent threshold at all, and the test row reads 'no overflow, no collision at every window', while the 'beside at 380/389/390' and 'own row at 379' expectations become font-dependent and must be rewritten; on the runner the speaker would be on its own row at 380 and 389 and, with 1.6 px, maybe at 390 as well, which breaks 'the mockup keeps 390 side by side' on this font. (D) the owner accepts the sample's phone as side by side on the Mac font and gives the runner's font a tolerance: only possible as a test change (the e2e sets a font stack with the same metrics as the Mac's, for example by loading a metric-compatible local font file in the test), which pins the platform instead of fixing the layout: I do not recommend it.

RECOMMENDATION: (C) in the code, with the rows in the test rewritten by the same step 5b, because it is the only one that survives platform font differences as the task asks and it needs no new threshold number; if the owner wants 390 px side by side kept on every font, (A) with 388 px is the least change but is the same no-slack defect (0.6 px at 389, 1.6 at 390 on the runner's font) and will fail again on a slightly wider font. ORCH decides; steps 3, 4 and 5b follow whichever code or test edit is chosen.
